name: Clips
description: Saves the last seconds of your game as a video: press a key, or let it happen after a kill. Off until you switch the replay buffer on; it records only while you play and stays light on your PC.

setting.buffer.desc: Keeps the last seconds in memory so you can save them. Clips show your screen, including chat.
setting.length.desc: How much is saved when you press the key. With long rewind this is the length of automatic clips and the suggested cut.
setting.longRewind.desc: Keeps up to 10 minutes instead of 2 – on the disk instead of in memory. The key then saves the whole rewind; you can trim it later in the launcher.
setting.rewindMinutes.desc: How many minutes the buffer keeps. About 45 MB per minute at medium quality (720p).
setting.encoder.desc: Auto picks your graphics card's video encoder (NVIDIA, AMD or Intel) and falls back to Windows'.
setting.autoClips.desc: Saves a clip on its own after a kill. Uses only what the game already shows you.
setting.autoMultiKill.desc: Two or more kills within 10 seconds become one clip.
setting.autoClutch.desc: A kill at 3 hearts or less, or the last of several attackers.
setting.postRoll.desc: Seconds after the last kill that still go into the clip.
setting.lowFpsPause.desc: Stops recording while the game struggles, so playing always comes first.
setting.fpsAuto.desc: Clip frame rate + 10 (40 at 30 fps), never above what your frame cap allows.
setting.inInventories.desc: Off: recording pauses while an inventory, chest or other container is open. Chat is always recorded.
setting.diskCap.desc: The most the long rewind may use. At least 1 GB always stays free.
setting.folderLimit.desc: When the folder grows above this, the oldest clips go first. Kept clips are never deleted.
setting.saveServer.desc: Off, or when the server or your privacy setting hides it, clips only say "Multiplayer".
setting.indicator.desc: A small dot in the corner while the buffer records; amber when it is paused.
